summary: Prevas AB provides technical solutions in Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and internationally. The company offers digital transformation, design and user experience, industrial digitalization, embedded systems automation, internal logistics, and mechanical development solutions. It also provides system deliveries, maintenance systems, energy, electricity and installations, testing and regulatory requirements, defense and security, chemical loading and unloading stations, life science and medtech innovation, and management solutions. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Västerås, Sweden.
